rules: Never invoke a profile whose cost_class is not zero.
Never use promotional credit as a durability dependency.
Cloud quota exhaustion must fall through to another zero-cost profile.
A local Ollama path must remain available as the final continuity layer.
Persist routing state so failed providers can cool down.
Z.ai automatic routing is restricted to glm-4.7-flash and glm-4.5-flash through the hard-allowlisted adapter.
GLM-5.2 trial is opportunistic only and must not enter the automatic provider pool.
GLM-5.2 Coding Plan is optional subscription capacity and must remain disabled unless explicitly enabled outside absolute-zero mode.
Paid GLM-5.2 API usage is hard-blocked in absolute-zero mode.
Never silently fall back from a free Z.ai route to any paid Z.ai model or endpoint.
